title: Scamming App
body: Do not even attempt to try this app. You cannot cancel the subscription. You will need to contact your bank to block their payments. And there is no customer service to reach out to

title: Avoid Subscribing
body: It is quite literally impossible to cancel your subscription, and impossible to get ahold of their “help” to actually receive help. If i could rate negative stars i would.

title: Scam!
body: Wont let me cancel subscription. Not worth the money.

title: Won’t let me cancel!
body: Started with a great story, so downloaded the app and purchased what I thought was a one week membership. But, the story dragged on and started to seem as if different parts were written by different people, changing the storyline multiple times. Then, when I tried to cancel it wouldn’t let me, because it’s a “guest subscription.” It doesn’t show up in Apple for me to cancel, either. I’m still waiting for a reply from their customer service.

title: Always read reviews
body: Always read the reviews before you download and subscribe. Had I done that I would have known to just not bother with this company. I’m stuck in a subscription that I can’t get out of. There is no way to unsubscribe in the actual App Store.

title: SCAM
body: Do not initiate any sort of subscription with them. They say it’s easy to manage, but it is not. The hide the cancellation option deep within the app and it was very hard to find. The subscription did not show up in Apple Subscriptions like it said it would. It would not allow me to cancel my auto-renewal and told me I had to wait until a certain time/date. When the time came and went, I tried again and got the same message with the same date and time. I reached out to cancel and got no response. Upon further investigation a lot of the instructions and directions are poorly translated and sketchy. I’m currently working with my card provider to block them. THIS IS A SCAM. DO NOT USE THIS APP.

title: How do I cancel the subscription?
body: I bought the week subscription but then decided to cancel but I can’t find it anywhere to cancel. It’s not in Apple subscriptions and there is nowhere on the app to cancel. So where do I go and how do I cancel it

title: Can’t get help when you need it.
body: Somehow my subscription is not in my Apple subscriptions and I can’t cancel my automatic renewal in the app. I tried to get help through the 1v1 service in the app but had no response.

title: Fraud! Cannot cancel memberships
body: I love to read so i did a weekly as a trial run. I had issues where i would have to exit the app and go back in several times for it to register i had the membership as it kept making me try to get coins for chapters where i was supposed to have the whole book. After a few times it would work. The last day i decided i would just cancel for the cost and the others options i have it mint worth it to me with all the glitches. Well the. It would not allow me to cancel and told me to go through the apple subscriptions went i went to there it shows i don’t have one so thinking this may be why it’s glitching it’s not even showing i have one i let it go and went on. The next day it charged me for the vip. I went through all the process again and tried to do the override provided by feedback to cancel and it gives an error which i provided all to their feedback team they advised they cancelled it but even with screen shots the could not refund the subscription the same day it had processed again. Very annoying since it wasn’t showing active for me to cancel it myself. They will just take your money and honestly there are so many other reading options this one is NOT worth it!

title: Terrible do not use scam
body: Took my money but didn’t give me the coins

title: Stop
body: Stop don’t download this app they are a scam, they get you into auto renewal that you can’t cancel. Even if you delete the app or cancel your account they will continue to charge your card. They don’t give you a receipt for the transaction but your bank will get the notification of the payment. They had some good stories but honestly it’s such a scam.

title: Horrible App
body: This app is a big time scam. The books need major reviewing for grammar and spelling. Coined that were supposed to be to read the whole book was not true. Also it kept taking me back to beginning chapters each time I logged in to read. Overall I would not recommend on any level.

title: Awful
body: They charge a ridiculous amount for chapters. If you were to read an entire book it would cost you $100. And the watching 3 adds/videos to unlock each chapter only works for a few times then you pay or can’t continue reading. Lots of typos in the “books”. Don’t waste your time or money! I’d give zeros stars but not an option. No way is this app over 4 stars.

title: Don’t waste your time
body: …unless you want to pay $$$ to finish a book. No visible way to turn rewards for watching adds to coins to open chapters. Authors.. try another format if you want readers to actually read your entire book

title: Expensive
body: The story is good, but you have to buy coins to unlock the chapter. I’ve already spent $15 and I’m not finished with the one story. It should be a flat fee per month or at least per story. Definitely not worth it.

title: Total scam
body: Unintelligible bonus/ coin system that makes it impossible to figure out what you have to actually pay to read a whole book. $29.99 in and app is demanding more $, but zero indication of how much more total. Story not bad, and I’d love to find it, read it but I’m not paying $60+… crazy…

title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD ITS A SCAM
body: Please do not download you will get hooked on a story that never ends and will spend like $100-200 trying to find out what happens next. And that’s a good outcome it might be more

title: Worthless
body: I will NEVER use this app, read its books, pay the ridiculous amount of money for these ridiculous books nor will I ever even try to earn coins. WORTHLESS WASTE OF TIME. Deleted instantly.

title: Makes no sense
body: This app is not user friendly. Once you click on a chapter you can’t go back to anything. I have to close the entire app to do anything. It doesn’t show you how many chapters there are. I logged out and came back the day after and had to scroll all the way down to where I had left off, but before I can even get there, the app tried to make me pay for pages I already read.

title: Ex Husband Apology
body: Don’t bother reading this book it unfinished cost is too expensive

title: Expensive waste of time
body: They just want your money. It is the only way to read the books

title: Not worth it.
body: Not sure how this app has a 4.4 rating you can’t convert the bonuses to the coins to actually read any chapters after watching all the videos you might be able to buy two chapters in a day. Books are over 400 chapters which are only a few pages long. then they change how much they charge for the chapters very randomly. It had been consistent with 50 for the first chapter 30 for the second and then all of a sudden it’s 50 for the first chapter and 46 coins for the second when you can only get coins in increments of five. Took screenshots to show when I had 29 coins the next chapter was 30 coins. Went and got more coins and had 34 and they changed the price to 35 within 15 minutes. Rip off. Your coins disappear with no warning and with no explanation. Honestly not worth the hassle.

title: Waste of money
body: Why would I download an app to pay for each chapter of a book when I can go buy the book for the $30 I’d spend on 5 chapters. You’d be better off just going to buy the book.

title: Expensive
body: To purchase reading the chapters is very expensive, you can spend more that $30 and you only get have the book. Books don’t even coast that much. Also there is transfer fee from your bank if you do purchase coins.

title: Too expensive
body: Looks like its going to take me 6 months to finish reading current book because im not spending anymore $. Only 1 short chapter per day is unlocked after watching a few ads. Not spending $60-100 on a book while still having to watch ads.

title: Membership is a scam!
body: Membership is falsely advertised it doesn’t give you extra coins everyday it only gives you the one time purchase ones and they don’t bother to help you out if you message them about it.

title: Terrible reward system
body: You can’t earn coins you have to buy them which wouldn’t be a problem if the bonuses you watched ads for and earned while reading actually worked. You can earn like 500 points a day that are SUPPOSED to turn into bonuses so you can read, but they only do it once every 24 hours and they only turn 100 of your points into 20 bonuses. What the heck is the point. You literally are keeping people from reading excellently written book because you’re being greedy and wanting people to buy stuff. And the bonuses you earn are enough for maybe one or two chapters a day. SO NOT ENOUGH. You’re ripping off your readers and making your authors lose following because they can’t afford to keep reading.

title: Point/bonus/rewards
body: This is a joke when it comes to opening chapters. You don’t get the promised conversions. I am up to 1000plus points that only give me 100bonus coins to read the chapters. I will be deleting this and going elsewhere. It’s a waste of time trying to read any of the stories. Then when you do get the bonus coins the chapters swallow them up in just two chapters. Not happy about the way any of the “credits” are handled. If it is to rate the stories. I love them but not enough to get by on the coins situation.

title: Run
body: Charged me three times for the same amount. Good luck getting any of that back, no Paypal protection. A novel may cost you $80+ dollars to finish. Just run, don't get sucked in. Buy a $3 kindle book instead and save yourself a ton of money.

title: Crappy app, just go somewhere else instead
body: What’s the point of the other “rewards” if you can’t use them to get chapters? You can’t earn coins, you can only buy them. If you let people earn them by watching the ads then you might get a bigger following of the app. Literally got the app and deleted it not even 5 minutes later. It’s a waste of time when there’s better apps out there that’ll actually let you get chapters without spending money.

title: Ridiculously Expensive
body: I got caught up in the start of the story on Facebook. So I downloaded the app and started reading. I spent $1.99 to buy 300 coins that ran out so I started scrolling to see how many chapters there were stopped scrolling at 200. Figuring that 30 coins per chapter was going to cost me more than four hardcover books which is absolutely ridiculous. New York Times best selling authors don’t even get that much money for a hardcover book and you want us to pay that for an e-book????? I’m done with this don’t waste your money or your time.

title: Doesn’t save place
body: I paid to unlock chapters and when I accidentally closed the app it now wants me to pay to unlock those chapters again

title: Annoying
body: It’s a good app until you have to get 40 to unlock a chapter when it says 40 but it won’t unlock. Also every time I would watch an add to get more bonus to unlock a chapter it would give me gems and not let me read the chapter. It’s just all together a nuisance app and would recommend you find another app.

title: A scam
body: They charged me when I did not order or subscribe to anything. I was even on the app around that time or for a long while. I would give it negative stars if possible.

title: Not worth it
body: This app is money hungry. It requires coins to open up any new chapters. You get bonus points but I have yet to find out what they are for. Can’t use them to unlock a chapter that I can see. Not worth it at all.

title: Do not sign up for their membership!
body: I signed on for a membership and got my first set of bonuses but never once got my daily check in bonus of 690 even though I sign in every day. I have gone to WhatsApp and contacted the support email with all the proof I have including my proof of purchase my daily check ins and used coins and bonus. I waited 4 day instead of the 72 hours and heard nothing back so I contacted Apple support and reported everything I sent report and asked for my $29.99 to be refunded and they have ignored me as well. So be prepared to have your money stolen and be ignored if you sign up for a membership I’ve bought coins no problems.

title: Rip off
body: I actually bought coins to finish my book and when I clicked continue to read my book it kicked me back 40 chapters to almost the beginning of the book. Can’t get in contact with support through the WhatsApp total freaking scam don’t download

title: Be careful
body: I purchased a few coins, 4.99 500 coins worth just to see if I would like the story more and it wouldn’t let me press it so I had to go search the story that I had reached chapter 8 or 9 i had to scroll all the way where I was and guess what it took of all of the coins I had just bought 500 coins. I just bought so be careful that you’re not getting conned out of your money. I won’t be buying any more coins because if this happens with a little bit, I can only imagine what happens when you buy more this is insane. I’ve never had this happen with any of the reading apps I’ve tried never again!!

title: Took my money in app malfunction
body: Top up stopped working and would not give me the coins and then still charged my account and haven’t heard back on a refund nor the issue and so expensive for absolutely no reason

title: Expensive & Not Finished
body: A story caught my eye and I started reading it, I even purchased the VIP and discounted coins for me I ended up spending almost $60 just to read to the end and the book is not even completed! I’ve been checking often to finish the read and nothing! I think the chapters should be cheaper and if a book is not finished it should be done by a certain time! So upset the book leaves you on a cliffhanger and there’s no one to ask questions too.

title: Great stories but too expensive
body: I got caught up in one of the stories through social media and I just had to finish. I downloaded the app and continued read. Due to the fact you have to pay buy chapter, just to finish 219 chapters I had to pay over $60. I can get a whole book read to me for $15 or buy a book for less than $30. Oh and the book is not even finished. So I will leave for now and not recommended this app until that is fixed. You could do so much better with this service if you were not so greedy because you have great content people would enjoy.

title: Lost bonuses
body: I keep watching the ads for the bonuses and they disappear after one use for a chapter. I’d have enough for two or three chapters and after one use the rest are gone. What is going on?

title: A waste really
body: Unlocked chapters with coins just to come back later to have them locked again? Smells scam-y to me.. app doesn’t save your spot in the story so hope you can remember where you left off. I won’t waste any more money on this app

title: Couple Issues 2
body: I agree with the fact that it will change the amount of coins it takes and I even took pictures thinking I was loosing my mind . But that’s not the only thing the app does it will charge you your coins but open the chapter after the chapter you need open. For example let’s say your on chapter 49 and you need chapter 50 to open first it will say you have enough coins then it will change to where you don’t have enough coins and then it will take your coins and open up chapter 51 though you still haven’t read chapter 50 so now it takes that much longer opening the chapter you are ACTUALLY trying to read. And yes I have SCREENSHOT PICTURES to prove what I’m saying to be true and Factual.

title: It’s started good
body: I don’t like that they have you earn points to be converted into bonuses and they don’t even convert your whole amount and then it’s unfair conversion it’s 100 points and then you get 20 bonuses that’s doesn’t make since they make it difficult to read meaning one way or another if you get this app they’re going to try and get you to buy some coins that don’t last long you only get to convert your points one time a day and then you have to wait until another 24 hrs goes by and it’s stupid the app says that 300 of your point automatically get converted and that is not what happened cause I had like 900 and it only took 100 it’s false advertising

title: It’s OK
body: Saw this on a fb ad and decided to give it a try. The read is decent HOWEVER the coins to read a chapter are wayyy to expensive. So far I’ve seen it be as high as 45 coins. The bonus tickets can be converted into coins from my understanding but it doesn’t seem easy. It says that you can watch a video for bonus tickets and gems but it’s literally not worth it as you only get like 5 bonus tickets everytime. To buy coins is expensive as well. I can definitely see them milking each read for what they can get. The beginning chapters used to be 30 coins and the price to read each chapter just keeps going up.

title: Please fix
body: This app doesn’t let me watch ads need to fix that. It always says no ad available. I want to read more than one chapter a day

title: Too expensive
body: This app has great content but they get 3 stars because there are so many issues with the app and some books will end up costing over $100 to read fully.

title: Couple issues
body: I like the app but when I try to unlock chapters it’ll say it’s 30 coins to unlock but when I get 30 coins it’s not enough to unlock the chapter, for a while it would make me get 40 coins before unlocking but now it’s making me get 50 coins even though it still says the chapter is only 30 coins, and the chapters aren’t even any longer, they’re the same length they just keep getting more expensive without actually telling you how much the chapters actually cost. That makes unlocking chapters so much harder cuz you don’t get a lot of coins a day.
